mentions.name: Chaffiti
mentions.description: A conversation layer for the internet that lets any webpage have a comment section, so users can see discussion and context directly on the page they're viewing instead of checking multiple separate services. Currently in iOS and macOS alpha testing.
mentions.problem: Minimizes the need to reference multiple services to get context on whatever you want information on, such as a potential employer, service provider, property manager, or real estate listing.
mentions.audience: Consumers who want background context on employers, service providers, property managers, and real estate listings without consulting multiple services.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m tinkering with adding a conversation layer to the internet whereby any webpage can have a comment section. Ideally this would minimize the need to reference multiple services to get context on whatever you want information on (think potential employer or service provider, property manager, real estate listing, etc…)

I’m calling it Chaffiti and it’s in iOS + MacOS alpha testing.
